info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v3-spec
info.description: This API enables users to fetch a comprehensive list of rideshare rides associated with a specific driver. It provides crucial insights into the rides completed, allowing monitoring and analysis of driver performance over time. Typical consumers include rideshare managers and operations teams seeking to evaluate driver activity and optimize service delivery. By leveraging this functionality, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve driver engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve rides associated with a specific driver.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the rides that are linked to a particular driver. Use this to review ride history and status for driver-related operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about the rides associated with a specific driver. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters in the JSON format as specified in the schema.
